evals.prompt: Apply prd-ralph-loop as a dry-run protocol simulation. Read only evals/files/complete/worker.json, which is a simulated worker return or caller input, not a manifest. Do not read prd.json or progress files and do not spawn real workers. Save outputs/decision.json and outputs/decision.md. Include status, next_action, target_task_id (null because worker owns selection), routing_decision. Use complete, looping, or blocked. All tasks passed. Stop; no task selection. decision.md must contain exactly <promise>COMPLETE</promise>.
evals.expected_output: All tasks passed. Stop; no task selection.
assertions: All tasks passed. Stop; no task selection.

evals.prompt: Apply prd-ralph-loop as a dry-run protocol simulation. Read only evals/files/dependent/worker.json, which is a simulated worker return or caller input, not a manifest. Include status, next_action, target_task_id (null because worker owns selection), routing_decision. Use complete, looping, or blocked. Dispatch one fresh worker without reading manifest/progress or choosing an ID. Begin decision.md with the TASK_COMPLETE protocol, retain the worker selected-task summary, and describe fresh prd-ralph dispatch.
evals.expected_output: Dispatch one fresh worker without reading manifest/progress or choosing an ID.
assertions: Dispatch one fresh worker without reading manifest/progress or choosing an ID.
